active_hypotheses: Safe next UC optimization is a narrow Monomachine DSP2 CVR poll-loop accelerator: detect exact `move.b $600001,D0; blt` loop at 0x248214 after a real taken branch, perform each synthetic taken iteration by still reading CVR so existing callbacks and DSP catch-up run, account exactly 7 ColdFire cycles, and stop before any timer/UART/MIDI/panel/flash/host-pump/deferred-host-RX/IRQ boundary.
Do not implement a pure HREQ/time jump: $600001 is CVR, HREQ is ISR at $600002. Blindly adding UC cycles would skip m_readCvrCallback and break DSP catch-up/HREQ timing.

DSP max-slice spikes are likely cold/JIT/host-timing one-offs, not scheduler clamp or recompile storm; prior JITSTATS history refuted a recompile storm with scattered symmetric compile counts. A diagnostic build with MD_TRANSPORT_DIAGNOSTICS=ON can verify clamp hits if needed.
